question: The chemical formula of the compound sodium carbonate is represented as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Na2CO3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The chemical formula of **Sodium Carbonate** is **Na2CO3**. It is an inorganic compound.
 
• It is composed of two **Sodium (Na)** atoms, one **Carbon (C)** atom, and three **Oxygen (O)** atoms.
 
• The formation of the formula is based on the **valency** of the constituent ions. The **Sodium ion** has a valency of **+1 (Na+)**, while the **Carbonate ion** has a valency of **-2 (CO3²-)**. To balance the charges, two sodium ions are required for every one carbonate ion, resulting in **Na2CO3**.
